items.summary: ゲームイベント「SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026」会場では，独創的なアイデアで注目を集めるインディータイトルが多数展示されている。そのなかでも，一風変わった世界観と骨太なシステムで来場者にアピールしているのが，地獄を舞台にしたデッキ構築型ローグライク「HellHold'em」だ。

zh.title: 通过作弊扑克在地狱中生存。其中“666”发挥最强的《地狱德州扑克》是一款将roguelike与德州扑克完美结合的非凡作品。
zh.summary: 在游戏盛会“SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026”上，展出了许多以其原创想法而受到关注的独立游戏。其中，以地狱为背景的卡组构筑Roguelike游戏《HellHold'em》以其独特的世界观和强大的系统吸引着游客。

en.title: Survive hell with cheat poker. ``Hell Hold'em'', where ``666'' plays the strongest role, is a remarkable work that perfectly combines roguelike and Texas Hold'em.
en.summary: At the game event "SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026", many indie titles that are attracting attention with their original ideas are on display. Among them, ``HellHold'em,'' a deck-building roguelike set in hell, is appealing to visitors with its unique worldview and robust system.

items.title: 3つのイベントを統合した南ヨーロッパ最大級のゲームイベント「SAGA Barcelona Game Fest 2026」が開催。ゲスト国の日本からはゲーム音楽のレジェンドも参加
items.summary: スペイン・バルセロナで「SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026」が10月9日から11日まで開催中だ。3つのイベントを統合した新たなゲームイベントで，第1回のゲスト国には日本を選出された。東野美紀氏と松前真奈美氏によるトークセッションも行われる。

zh.title: SAGA 巴塞罗那游戏节 2026 是南欧最大的游戏活动之一，将举办三项活动。来自主宾国日本的游戏音乐传奇人物也参与其中。
zh.summary: “SAGABarcelonaGameFest2026”将于10月9日至11日在西班牙巴塞罗那举行。这是一项由三个项目合并而成的新游戏赛事，日本被选为首个主宾国。还将与东野美纪 (Miki Higashino) 和松前真奈美 (Manami Matsumae) 进行座谈会。

en.title: Preview of "Shadow Blade Zero": A quite complete journey of exploration and combat
en.summary: On September 3, Chule participated in the closed offline trial session of "Shadow Blade Zero" at the invitation of Lingyoufang. The important thing about this demo is that the version available at the event is arguably not that different from the version that will be released soon. During the approximately 5 hours of trial play, we had a relatively complete experience of the story opening, plot CG, level design and boss battles, and even details such as controller feedback. The process covered the entire first chapter of the big map, hidden maps, hidden bosses, a small amount of the second chapter content and two later bosses. If the previous demos released sporadically by Lingyoufang still gave people a feeling of peeking into the background, this time the demos make people feel quite reassured about the overall quality of the game. In terms of exploration and combat experience, "Shadow Blade Zero" maintains a consistently high level; in particular, games in the past have shown less in terms of levels and development, and this time it also brought us the biggest surprise. en.title: Why can "Onmyoji", which is in its tenth year, still allow players to crowd out the Canton Tower?

There were a lot of people at the scene, but it was not noisy. Most people were talking to friends at a moderate volume, or chatting nearby or on the Yin Yang Liao channel in the game. Generally speaking, they were very relaxed and comfortable. Behind me was a cosplayer who cosplayed as an Inugami. At first he was taking photos with other people, but then he seemed a little tired. He sat down cross-legged, took off his hood and held it in his arms. His face was very red and there was sweat on his forehead. The weather in Guangzhou these days is indeed very hot. In a sense, this "heat" also connects my usual feelings about "Onmyoji": intimacy, warmth, and longevity. Players waiting for the show to start gathered under the stage. Suddenly, there was some small commotion among the players on the side of the stage: a girl seemed to be standing up to hand out homemade materials, and the entire scene immediately became lively.

items.title: ADHDの人は便秘や過敏性腸症候群などの「腸の問題」を抱えやすいことが約200万人の分析で判明
items.summary: 注意欠如多動症(ADHD)は不注意や衝動性を特徴とする発達障害であり、世界全体では成人の2～4％がADHDを持っているといわれています。イギリスのウォーリック大学が主導した研究では、ADHDを持つ人は便秘や過敏性腸症候群(IBS)、下痢といった胃腸症状を経験する可能性が著しく高いとの結果が示されました。続きを読む...

zh.title: 对约 200 万人的分析显示，患有多动症的人更有可能出现“肠道问题”，例如便秘和肠易激综合症
zh.summary: 注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）是一种以注意力不集中和冲动为特征的发育障碍，据说全球有2-4%的成年人患有ADHD。英国华威大学领导的一项研究发现，患有多动症的人明显更容易出现胃肠道症状，如便秘、肠易激综合症（IBS）和腹泻。阅读更多...

en.title: Analysis of about 2 million people reveals that people with ADHD are more likely to have ``intestinal problems'' such as constipation and irritable bowel syndrome
en.summary: Attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD) is a developmental disorder characterized by inattention and impulsivity, and it is said that 2-4% of adults worldwide have ADHD. A study led by the University of Warwick in the UK found that people with ADHD were significantly more likely to experience gastrointestinal symptoms such as constipation, irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and diarrhea. read more...

items.title: 病院の給水システムが原因で患者40人が細菌に感染
items.summary: イギリス・ケンブリッジのロイヤル・パプワース病院では、2019年から院内の給水システムを感染源とする細菌の集団感染が起きていました。この集団感染を調査したイギリス保健安全保障庁などの研究チームが2026年9月29日に発表した論文によると、院内の水から見つかった菌と同じ系統の菌が患者40人から検出されたとのことです。続きを読む...

items.title: バックアップはなぜ難しいのか、ファイルをコピーするだけでは済まない理由とは？
items.summary: 故障や操作ミスなどによって大切なデータが失われることがあるため、日頃からバックアップを取っておくことは重要です。しかし、データのバックアップは単にファイルを別の場所にコピーするだけでは十分とは限りません。ソフトウェアエンジニアのアレクサンダル・フィリポフスキー氏が、バックアップの仕組みを整えるにつれて増えていく課題を、自身の体験を交えて説明しています。続きを読む...

en.title: Why is backup so difficult? Why is it more than just copying files?

Software engineer Aleksander Filipovsky explains from his own experience the challenges that arise as you set up a backup system. read more...
